现在王野家也可以吃二合面的馒头了，虽然对于王野来说还是不多，但是每天吃一粒药丸，在没有大的消耗体力时，也不会有饥饿感。

吃完饭，秦婉收拾了桌子，王野带着弟弟妹妹回房了，小丫头玩了半天早累了。王野抱着没一会儿就睡着了，王江河一直看着王野。看得王野都心毛了了，没好气的说：“先去睡午觉，一会儿睡醒了给你做！”

“大哥……”

“快睡，不睡不给做了。”

王江河听见这话，赶紧闭上眼睛睡觉了。

看着两小只睡着了，王野就把做好的两个包拿出来，放在炕头。拿着蒲扇给小丫头轻轻的扇着。不知不觉自己也睡着了。

正在王野是睡得正香时，就听见了小丫头“咯咯”的笑声。王野睁开眼睛，看见王笑笑又开始骑布老虎了。王野在小丫头骑到自己身边时，一把抱住王笑笑，逗弄了一会儿，拿起旁边的小青蛙背包，温柔的问：“看看漂亮吗？喜欢不？”

王笑笑看着小背包，眼都直了：“漂漂！蛤蟆！”

“臭丫头，不是蛤蟆，是青蛙，呱呱叫的青蛙。”

“青蛙呱呱！青蛙呱呱！”

王野给小丫头背上小包，还往里面放了几块儿水果糖和大白兔。还有她那个宝贝的竹蜻蜓。小丫头背上小包，还扭着脑袋往后看。然后就让王野给穿上鞋下了炕。

王笑笑一下去就跑了出去，直奔院里的秦婉。到了秦婉面前，原地起跳转了个身屁股对着秦婉，扭啊扭的。秦婉看见王笑笑背的小包，惊讶的说：“呀，这是个蛤蟆呀！”

王笑笑转过来奶声奶气的说：“不是，是呱呱，我的呱呱！”

“你大哥给你的？”

“大锅给！大锅给~”

王野正好也出来了，秦婉瞅了一眼王野：“没事儿你给她做个包干嘛，她才多大呀。”

“娘，这不是我做完包剩下了点布料嘛！小丫头做个小包，她也能装她的宝贝了。”

“她有个屁的宝贝！你就是浪费，这帆布修补鞋子可好了。”

王野嬉皮笑脸的：“做都做了，拆了多浪费呀！”

小丫头也懂了：“不给，我的！”

王江河看着王笑笑的小包，那是真羡慕，就凑了过来：“大哥，我也想要。”

王野可不会惯着弟弟：“你不是有书包吗？要什么要。”

“可是我的书包都旧了......”

“旧了也新过呀，当时你有新书包时，妹妹也没吵着要呀！”

王江河想想也是，可想了一下，不对呀：“大哥，我有书包时还没有妹妹呢！”

王野把这茬儿忘了，可是王野多不要脸呀！立刻威胁道：“那你还要不要枪呀？”

Now Wang Ye's family can also eat steamed buns from Erhe Noodles. Although it is still not much for Wang Ye, taking one pill every day will not cause hunger when there is no major exertion of energy.

After dinner, Qin Wan cleared the table, and Wang Ye took his younger brothers and sisters back to their room. The little girl was tired after playing for a long time.Wang Ye fell asleep after holding her for a while. Wang Jianghe kept looking at Wang Ye.Wang Ye was so upset that he said angrily: "Go and take a nap first. I'll do it for you when I wake up later!"

"Brother..."

"Go to sleep quickly. If you don't sleep, you won't be able to do anything."

When Wang Jianghe heard this, he quickly closed his eyes and went to sleep.

Seeing the two little ones falling asleep, Wang Ye took out the two bags he had made and placed them on the end of the kang.He took the cattail leaf fan and fanned the little girl gently.Unknowingly, I also fell asleep.

When Wang Ye was sleeping soundly, he heard the little girl's laughter.Wang Ye opened his eyes and saw Wang Xiaoxiao starting to ride the cloth tiger again.When the little girl rode next to him, Wang Ye hugged Wang Xiaoxiao and teased her for a while. Then he picked up the little frog backpack next to him and asked gently: "Does it look pretty? Do you like it?"

Wang Xiaoxiao looked at the small backpack, his eyes widened: "Piao Piao! Toad!"

"Smelly girl, it's not a toad, it's a frog, a croaking frog."

"Frog croak! Frog croak!"

Wang Ye carried a small bag on the little girl's back and put a few pieces of fruit candies and white rabbits in it.And her precious bamboo dragonfly.The little girl put the small bag on her back and turned her head to look back.Then he asked Wang Ye to put on his shoes and get off the bed.

Wang Xiaoxiao ran out and went straight to Qin Wan in the courtyard.When he arrived in front of Qin Wan, he jumped up and turned his butt towards Qin Wan, twisting and twisting.Qin Wan saw the small bag Wang Xiaoxiao was carrying and said in surprise: "Ah, this is a toad!"

Wang Xiaoxiao turned around and said in a sweet voice, "No, it's Guagua, my Guagua!"

"Your elder brother gave it to you?"

"Here's the big pot! Here's the big pot~"

Wang Ye also came out. Qin Wan glanced at Wang Ye and said, "It's okay. Why are you making her a bag? How old is she?"

"Mom, isn't this some fabric left over after I made the bag? Let the little girl make a small bag so that she can hold her baby."

"She has a damn baby! You are a waste, this canvas is great for repairing shoes."

Wang Ye smiled playfully: "I've done it all, how wasteful it would be to dismantle it!"

The little girl also understood: "No, it's mine!"

Wang Jianghe looked at Wang Xiaoxiao's little bag with real envy, so he came over and said, "Brother, I want it too."

Wang Ye would not spoil his younger brother: "Don't you have a schoolbag? Ask for whatever you want."

"But my schoolbag is old..."

"Everything old is new again. When you got a new schoolbag, your sister didn't even clamor for it!"

Wang Jianghe thought about it, but after thinking about it, he realized that something was wrong: "Brother, I didn't have a sister when I had my schoolbag!"

Wang Ye forgot about this problem, but Wang Ye is so shameless!He immediately threatened: "Then do you still want a gun?"
